categories.main_business_segments: NARI Technology Co., Ltd. operates primarily in four business segments: Intelligent Grid, Digital-Energy Integration, Energy Low-Carbon, and Industrial Internet. These segments cover products and solutions for power grid automation, digital transformation of energy systems, green and low-carbon energy technologies, and industrial automation and control systems.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies including power system automation, digital integration technologies such as AI, big data, IoT, blockchain, and 5G, as well as power electronics like IGBT modules and flexible AC/DC transmission technologies. It employs order-based production with engineering design, procurement, proprietary technology integration, and system integration to deliver customized solutions.
categories.primary_customers_markets: NARI serves key customers in the energy and power sector including State Grid Corporation and its subsidiaries, power generation companies, municipal utilities, water conservancy, transportation (especially rail transit), and industrial enterprises. It also targets emerging markets like new energy, energy storage, and digital infrastructure both domestically and internationally.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across China, covering over 25 provinces, and has a growing international presence with subsidiaries and projects in countries such as Indonesia, Brazil, Nigeria, India, Malaysia, the UK, and Ecuador. Its overseas business is expanding rapidly, with significant projects in South America, Southeast Asia, Africa, and Europe.
categories.supply_chain_position: NARI operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the energy supply chain, focusing on power grid automation equipment manufacturing, system integration, and providing digital and intelligent solutions for energy transmission, distribution, and consumption. It also extends into upstream semiconductor manufacturing for power electronics components.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in smart grid technologies, digital-energy integration, low-carbon energy solutions, and industrial internet applications. It invests heavily in R&D, focusing on new energy system control, power electronics, AI, digital twins, cybersecurity, and energy storage technologies. It aims to lead in original innovation and core technology development aligned with national energy and digital strategies.
categories.revenue_model: NARI generates revenue mainly through product sales of electrical and digital equipment, system integration services, engineering contracting, and after-sales technical support. It also earns income from equipment leasing and emerging business models in digital and energy sectors. Revenue is largely derived from contracts with large state-owned enterprises and government projects.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic player and recognized market leader in intelligent power grid automation and energy digitalization in China. It holds a strong competitive position with a comprehensive product portfolio and extensive industry experience. Competitors include other major Chinese power equipment manufacturers and international suppliers in power automation and digital energy solutions.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, NARI achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 51.57 billion, representing a 10.13% year-over-year increase, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 7.18 billion, up 11.44%. The company maintains a robust growth trajectory with steady increases in R&D investment (6.71% of revenue) and expanding international business. Total assets reached RMB 86.09 billion, reflecting a 12.24% growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: NARI emphasizes its first-mover advantage, comprehensive industry ecosystem, and strong innovation capabilities with numerous proprietary technologies and patents. It offers integrated, customized solutions that enhance grid safety, efficiency, and digital transformation. The company’s products and services are recognized for high reliability, advanced technology, and strong after-sales support, positioning it as a trusted partner in China’s energy transition and digital economy.
